review_rules: Do not use developer commentary to erase differences among Nordic, Imperial and other cultural identifications of gods.
Claims about Cyrodiil's environmental presentation must retain source date, game context and whether the statement is in-world or developer commentary.
Talos identity models involving Tiber Septim, Wulfharth and Zurin Arctus remain separate unless a source explicitly connects them.
Pelinal metaphysical or futuristic interpretations require explicit provenance and should not be inferred from imagery alone.
Cross-link to existing Nordic religion, Imperial religion, Talos, Reman, Pelinal and Cyrodiil records.
